reason: The pass compares each gang's group with the one it would write field by field, without the reflection walk that copied every leaf: with the PodGroup API 30,807 to 17,847 allocations at 160 gangs of eight, 97,083 to 56,583 at 500, and 240,614 to 100,889 at the largest reference gang service, 1,725 gangs of a leader and one worker; without the API, where no group is compared, 13,468, 42,770 and 52,760, unchanged. The pass reads the owner's PodGroups from the informer cache through the controller-UID index and lists the apiserver only before a write or a reset, so the apiserver's PodGroup list is 0 and the cache's 1; without the API nothing is read. The pods are the cache's one list, 1 cached and 0 live. A gang at rest is read against the plan field by field, its group never built and never copied onto the inventory: with the PodGroup API 17,847 to 13,387 at 160 gangs of eight, 56,583 to 41,871 at 500, 100,889 to 48,202 at 1,725 gangs of two; without the API, where the pass still proves each gang's key through a set and a sorted list, unchanged. Without the API the pass proves each gang's key allocating nothing, through one walk over the generated terms instead of a set, a sorted list and a formatted index, twice per gang: 13,468 to 11,888 at 160 gangs of eight, 42,770 to 37,302 at 500, 52,760 to 32,592 at 1,725 gangs of two; with the API, where a settled gang is read without that proof, unchanged. The pass's own work per gang is gone: the pods are grouped by the index their PodGroup name spells and cut from one array, and every gang's record carries the name its pods already carry, three allocations per pod list in place of a map and a bucket grown per gang and a name formatted per gang: with the API 13,387 to 12082 at 160 gangs of eight, 41,871 to 37592 at 500, 48,202 to 36337 at 1,725 gangs of two; without it 11,888 to 10583, 37,302 to 33023, 32,592 to 20727. What remains is the cache's deep copy of every pod and, with the API, of every group. The pass's bytes and the pods the cache copies for it are held beside the allocations: 3,146,592 / 9,825,344 / 8,053,784 bytes without the API and 3,493,200 / 10,699,168 / 11,483,400 with it at 160 gangs of eight, 500 and 1,725 gangs of two, the cache copying 1,280, 4,000 and 3,450 pods per pass; the rows with the PodGroup API read 28 to 46 allocations below the recording of 2026-11-06 on today's main, inside the tolerance, and are re-recorded as read. The pass keeps no copy of the plan's entries and finds a gang by its index in a slice: without the API 10,583 to 10,580 allocations and 3,146,592 to 3,127,304 bytes at 160 gangs of eight, 33,023 to 33,020 and 9,825,344 to 9,763,816 at 500, 20,727 to 20,722 and 8,053,784 to 7,866,008 at 1,725 gangs of two; with it 12,054 to 12,051 and 3,493,200 to 3,473,912, 37,555 to 37,552 and 10,699,168 to 10,637,640, 36,291 to 36,286 and 11,483,400 to 11,295,624.
